articles.headline: Egor Demin scores 22 in his return as the Nets rout the Pelicans 145-111
articles.description: — Egor Demin returned from a six-game injury absence to score 22 points, Michael Porter Jr. also scored 22, and the Brooklyn Nets beat New Orleans 145-111 on Wednesday night, handing the Pelicans their fourth consecutive loss.

articles.headline: Jamal Murray, Nikola Jokic lead Nuggets to 123-118 win over Grizzlies
articles.description: — Jamal Murray scored 17 of his 30 points in the fourth quarter, Nikola Jokic added 27 points, 11 rebounds and eight assists, and the Denver Nuggets held off the Memphis Grizzlies 123-118 on Wednesday night.

articles.headline: Doncic, Mamukelashvili and Reaves lead Lakers past Bucks 123-112 for 7th straight win
articles.description: — Luka Doncic scored 32 points, Sandro Mamukelashvili added 23 and Austin Reaves 18 as the Los Angeles Lakers extended their winning streak to seven games with a 123-112 win over the Milwaukee Bucks on Wednesday night.
